reviews.title: Charged immediately / “free trial”
reviews.text: I have never had an app charge my card as soon as I signed up for a FREE trial, but this one did. I wanted to see why it was so expensive and was going to give it a try to see if it was worth it. I don’t trust a company that says free trial and then charges you $39.99 immediately for 2 months. I canceled immediately , so we’ll see if I have to fight to get my money back.

reviews.title: Won’t sync with phone
reviews.text:
I paid a ton of money for this app, it’s on my MacBook, the subscription is on my iPhone, but the app is trying to make me pay again on my phone. The apps won’t sync. There is no way to get past the “buy now” screen even though I have already bought it.

App looks great, I want to use it so bad, but I might have to cancel if this isn’t addressed ASAP.

reviews.title: Unimpressed
reviews.text: Maybe I’m just not familiar with how to use these kind of apps but this particular one was really hard to use. I couldn’t change the size of the font and whenever I wanted to move a text box to the left-hand side, it would be covered by the text box editor. I also expected there to be way more templates to use for $70 a year. My biggest pet peeve though was that there was actually no way to straighten or center any picture, sticker, or text box. There is no grid to tell you when it was centered or if it was not Straight.
